assets.subject: loose hay scattered on the floor
assets.detail: Loose golden hay and straw scattered on the floor in a soft irregular patch with ragged, thinning edges, a few stray stalks around it. No frame, no container, no animals, nothing else. Seen from directly overhead, lying flat on the floor. Real-world size about 60 in by 48 in. Variation 1: a different irregular outline.
